meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描 Azure 中的 Functions 与 App Service，检查可用区冗余、存储冗余、健康探测和多区域故障转移，生成功能分类的可靠性清单；你确认后，分阶段用 CLI 或 IaC 补丁修复。
howto.when: 当你提到“assess reliability”“zone redundant”“multi-region failover”等关键词，或要求检查可靠性、评估高可用、设置灾难恢复时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这个 Function App 的可靠性
say.note: 生成按功能的可靠性清单

say.text: 我的应用是可用区冗余的吗？
say.note: 检查计算和存储的区冗余状态

say.text: 把存储 SKU 改成 ZRS

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources, checks for zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes and multi-region failover, produces a feature-based reliability checklist, and after your confirmation drives staged fixes via CLI or IaC patches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", or ask to check reliability, evaluate high availability, or set up disaster recovery.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of this Function App.
